def process(noaa_wildfires, raws_stations):
    # NWS ID in RAWS overlaps with station_verified_in_psa in NOAA
    # NWS ID is a string like '227701', station_verified_in_psa is numeric
    raws = raws_stations.copy()
    raws['nws_id_num'] = pd.to_numeric(raws['NWS ID'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Get unique station IDs used in NOAA fires
    noaa_stations = noaa_wildfires[['station_verified_in_psa']].drop_duplicates()
    
    # Join NOAA station IDs with RAWS on NWS ID
    merged = noaa_stations.merge(
        raws[['nws_id_num', 'Elevation']],
        left_on='station_verified_in_psa',
        right_on='nws_id_num',
        how='inner'
    )
    
    avg_elev = merged['Elevation'].mean()
    return pd.DataFrame({'avg_elevation_ft': [round(avg_elev, 1)], 'matched_stations': [len(merged)]})
